units.source_text: 我出生在舞鹤东北一个伸向日本海的荒凉的海角。

en.t: I was born on a desolate cape northeast of Maizuru, jutting out into the Sea of Japan.

units.source_text: 老家不是这里，而是舞鹤东郊的志乐。

en.t: My family's original home was not there, but in Shiraku, on the eastern outskirts of Maizuru.

units.source_text: 根据众人的恳切期望，父亲遁入空门，当了偏僻的海角寺庙的住持，在当地娶了妻子，生下了我。

en.t: In response to everyone's earnest wishes, my father entered the Buddhist priesthood, became the head priest of a remote temple on the cape, took a wife there, and had me.
